say:2:1130635002:1.text: Whether a bounty hunter makes it home in one piece depends on the company they keep.
say:2:1130635002:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人遭遇不幸后，能不能完整地回来要看同伴的责任心。
say:2:1130635002:1.male: Whether a bounty hunter makes it home in one piece depends on the company they keep.
say:2:1130635002:1.female: Whether a bounty hunter makes it home in one piece depends on the company they keep.

say:3:1130635003:1.text: Carrying remains is no small task. Getting carried home in a box is a good way to make sure your partners also wind up dead.
say:3:1130635003:1.source_cn: 搬运遗体可不是小事，如果自己遇难，同伴还能存活的几率也不大。
say:3:1130635003:1.male: Carrying remains is no small task. Getting carried home in a box is a good way to make sure your partners also wind up dead.
say:3:1130635003:1.female: Carrying remains is no small task. Getting carried home in a box is a good way to make sure your partners also wind up dead.

say:4:1130635004:1.text: There are people who make a living hauling corpses, but it's up to you whether to trust them or not.
say:4:1130635004:1.source_cn: 我知道有人在干收敛遗体的活，但他们值不值得信任，就要看...
say:4:1130635004:1.male: There are people who make a living hauling corpses, but it's up to you whether to trust them or not.
say:4:1130635004:1.female: There are people who make a living hauling corpses, but it's up to you whether to trust them or not.
